anchor_rationale: Use the current Native model-specific query: Qwen after an explicit rank, Gemma at the preceding item end. Bullet has no numeric rank and uses preceding item end in both models. Discovery and intervention use exactly the same registered role.
discovery_rule: All locally eligible transitions at the registered query in the original 20 discovery N=10 traces, independently per model and mode. Do not filter on Update eligibility, final correctness, or intervention outcomes. Record excluded seeds and transitions.
ranking_metric: Mean attention probability mass to the next city prompt-record span; average queries within each true source seed, then seeds equally.
ranking_tie_break: Descending score, then ascending zero-based layer and head.
bank_size_rule: Keep the full Native dose grids and their fixed maximum K=128/6. Do not replace top-ranked heads or select K using behavioral outcomes.
random_rule: Three deterministic banks per source seed and dose, excluding the full selected bank. Prefer exact per-layer matching. Only when a layer has insufficient remaining heads at that dose, use global random from the same candidate-head universe and label the fallback and capacity reason. Selected doses are nested; random doses are nested within the same control type and repeat. Random repeats need not be mutually disjoint.
random_fallback_authorization: Use layer-matched random controls whenever feasible; allow a global fallback only when matching is infeasible.
confirmation_rule: For each of the original ten Read seeds, choose the highest N with the same legal final transition N-1 to N in both models of this format. Index requires explicit rank-before-city grammar. Bullet retains its invariant-marker grammar. No cross-format or Thinking intersection; no clean-correctness filter.
clean_rule: One clean continuation per source seed, shared across all doses.
smoke_rule: All four cells must pass geometry, finite-attention, exact-zero head slices, and persistent-hook checks before formal interventions. Scientific effect size is not an acceptance criterion.
